upright.short: Prosperity, independence, luck, praise, personal achievements.
upright.general: A stage of prosperity in life is expected soon. New projects may begin and will culminate in success, bringing moral satisfaction to the querent. The Ace of Pentacles always signifies personal growth. There is a possibility that you will begin spiritual practices or get a promotion at work. Having invested a lot into a matter, this card portends a successful resolution—it is time to gather the fruits of your labor. If you have a wealthy relative, expect part of an inheritance soon. Management will praise and thank you for your excellent work, possibly offering a bonus, as the card portends material benefits. Many opportunities are concentrated around you; do not miss your chance. It is often interpreted as the arrival of important information or a brilliant idea, with high income and the possibility of becoming famous expected soon.
upright.in_love: In love readings, it is interpreted as strong and long-term family bonds. Relationships between partners are built more on physical intimacy than a spiritual connection. It often indicates a sudden positive turn in romantic relationships. The card advises you to love yourself and your body, and treat yourself with due respect before looking for a soulmate. If interpreting a partner's character, it highlights their weak will. It may also show that someone simply wants to get you into bed quickly, putting minimal effort into courtship and rushing the relationship.
upright.in_situation: Start new endeavors; they will be successful and promise a good income. This is a favorable moment to implement plans that have been conceived for a long time. There is a probability that a very expensive and valuable gift awaits the querent. If funding is required to support an important project, there is no need to worry—your business will be funded. You will receive a reward for high-quality work, possibly even more than previously agreed upon with the client. If the person is a student, the card portends a successful defense of a thesis, practical work, or exam.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today, luck will be following you closely. Be extremely attentive and do not miss your chances, which may await you in various places and at the most unexpected times. Invest in long-term and realistic plans, especially regarding your career and earnings. If your plans are short-term, today will be an excellent starting point for far-reaching objectives.
upright.card_advice: Success and well-being depend entirely on you. Be more active, do not miss numerous opportunities, communicate more with people around you, and do not be afraid of new acquaintances, as they will bring useful connections. Right now, Fortune is facing you, so do not miss this moment. However, do not look only for material rewards in everything—do not forget about spiritual development and family.

reversed.general: The card hints at the same themes as the upright position but in a negative light. For example, wealth will not make you a happy person, or plans are not meant to come true. A calm internal state and the absence of a premonition of loss are quite deceptive. On an everyday level, delays in salary or payments for services are possible, causing many planned tasks to fail. There is a possibility of making hasty decisions that turn out to be wrong. Apart from material losses, the querent will rethink material values. In character readings, it signifies greed and egocentrism. The card also predicts states of anxiety, chronic fatigue, and health problems.
reversed.in_love: In new relationships, there will be many arguments due to incompatibility of interests and a lack of mutual understanding. The period of courtship before intimacy can drag on significantly. In relationship spreads, it shows that the union is built on convenience/calculation rather than love. If it falls to a woman, she feels like a hostage to the marriage, as if in a golden cage—externally everything looks perfect (wealthy husband, beautiful house, children), but she does not feel enough care, love, or respect, and lacks personal space.
reversed.in_situation: Problems will definitely arise in a new endeavor, bringing consequences that most likely involve material losses. Desires and goals will fail to realize for specific reasons. Expect salary delays, cancellation of bonus payments, or an employer's refusal to pay for completed work. Health problems will arise; if the illness started long ago, therapy will not yield the expected results, so do not skimp on consulting a good specialist. Do not commit hasty and thoughtless actions, as they can play a cruel joke on you.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today may bring financial uncertainty, delayed results, or disappointment connected with work, money, or practical matters. Be careful with impulsive spending, unrealistic expectations, or risky opportunities that seem too good to be true.
reversed.card_advice: Avoid hasty financial decisions and do not rely solely on luck or external promises. Patience, realistic planning, and careful attention to details will help you protect your stability and avoid unnecessary losses.
